basis: Gate 2 model/client deterministic assessment rules after correction
classification_rule: complete structured telemetry only when Trace.has_all_required_fields() is true

required_fields.trace_id: present only when every normalized span has a trace_id
required_fields.span_id: present only when every normalized span has a span_id
required_fields.parent_span_id: present when the field is represented for every span; root-only representation does not prove parent-child preservation
required_fields.span_name: present only when every normalized span has a name
required_fields.start_time: present only when every normalized span has a parseable start timestamp
required_fields.end_time: present only when every normalized span has an end timestamp or one can be computed from start_time plus duration_nano
required_fields.duration: present only when every normalized span has duration_nano
required_fields.status: present only when every normalized span has structured status fields
required_fields.complete attributes: present only when the attribute map exists and expected Gate 1A attributes are present
required_fields.resource attributes: present only when every normalized span has a non-empty resource attribute map
